title: Finite one-generation execution budget without a finite ambient Link universe
semanticClaim: Finite concrete current and admitted-Rule collections give a finite current×Rule comparison budget.
Finite explicit Rule images give a finite raw staging-occurrence budget for one concrete generation.
Nat-valued local-match cost makes local termination an explicit finite execution premise rather than an ambient-universe restriction.
The proof is polymorphic in Link and Rule Types and therefore assumes no finite ambient Link carrier.
explicitPremises: one concrete reaction exposes finite materialized/current/admission collections
each admitted Rule has a finite explicit image for the reaction
each local current×Rule match terminates with a finite Nat-valued work cost
staging counts raw finite image occurrences before canonical ANet membership convergence
exclusions: No finite ambient Link universe is assumed or derived.
No claim is made that all semantic ANets or all denotational reactions are finite.
Atomic publication is not derived from finite work; it remains independently governed by GPR-01/GPR-03.
The proof budgets raw occurrences; canonical duplicate convergence remains GPR-02/GPR-04.
